name: Later
description: Later is a social media management and visual scheduling platform designed for Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Facebook, and LinkedIn, featuring a visual drag-and-drop content calendar and Link in Bio tool.
best_for: Visual creators, ecommerce brands, and boutique social agencies focusing on Instagram, TikTok, and visual content marketing.
features: Visual Instagram Grid Planner allowing users to preview and rearrange feed aesthetics before posting
Auto-publishing for Instagram Reels, Carousels, TikToks, Pins, Facebook, and LinkedIn
Customizable Link in Bio landing page builder linking Instagram posts directly to product pages
User-generated content (UGC) discovery, media library storage, and hashtag suggestions
Best time to post AI recommendations based on historical audience engagement
Multi-profile social inbox for responding to Instagram comments and mentions

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: 1 user, 1 set of social profiles, 30 posts per profile (billed annually at $200/yr or $25/mo monthly).

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: 3 users, 3 sets of social profiles, 150 posts per profile.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.notes: 6 users, 6 sets of social profiles, unlimited posts.

pros: Visual Instagram feed grid preview and drag-and-drop planning
Robust Link in Bio feature turning Instagram traffic into trackable ecommerce sales
Intuitive media library with tag-based asset organization and UGC search
cons: Post volume caps on Starter (30 posts/profile) and Growth (150 posts/profile) tiers
B2B analytics for LinkedIn and Twitter/X are less detailed than Sprout Social or Buffer
No perpetual free plan; requires paid subscription after 14-day trial

alternatives.name: Buffer
alternatives.description: Simple, intuitive social media publishing, analytics, and engagement platform.
alternatives.best_for: Solopreneurs and small businesses wanting flexible multi-channel scheduling

alternatives.name: Sprout Social
alternatives.description: Enterprise social media management, listening, and customer care platform.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprise brands and agencies needing advanced social listening and CRM integration

alternatives.name: Hootsuite
alternatives.description: Comprehensive social media marketing dashboard for scheduling, monitoring, and ads.
alternatives.best_for: Marketing teams managing large multi-channel social presences
